Welcome to JaredWare's Microgame Tester! A place where you can make microgames!

Start at the backdrop where you'll decide on the length of your microgame and putting your music in.

Then head to commands. Voice and type what the player should do!

After that, go to DO NOT DELETE, copy it, then make your scripts.
No limits! Run wild!

Test your microgame and if it works, it works!
If not, Fix a few bugs and try again!

There is your tutorial! Good Luck!
- FreePlayArcade
